title: Stopping on the first error
hints: Workers report errors on a channel with a buffer of 1; use a select with a default case so only the first error is kept and nobody blocks. The dispatcher must stop handing out jobs once an error exists.

Use a quit channel that gets closed once, when the first error arrives. The dispatcher's send becomes a select between jobs <- i and <-quit. Closing exactly once needs coordination: let only the worker that wins the errCh send close quit.

select { case errCh <- err: close(quit); default: }  in a worker; the dispatcher: select { case jobs <- i: case <-quit: return }; after wg.Wait(): select { case err := <-errCh: return err; default: return nil }
